name: The Forbes house

status.note: Its later history is not researched here.

built.note: Standing in October 1871 (Andreas, volume two). Nobody recorded when it was built; 1864 stands in for the years before the fire.

summary: A frame house in two parts, two doors from the O'Learys. The Forbes family lived in front; the Lee and Connovan families rented the back.

notable.text: William Lee ran from here to a drug store to sound the fire alarm.

story.text: The fire breaks out in the O'Leary barn next door.
